text: Niranira's Panic Room (Japanese: , Nirunī no Kakushibeya) is a Location in . It is located in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Niranira can be found here during Chapter 5.

Naola Crustips (Japanese: , Naora Shuribu) are quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family and can be found at level 12 at the Greatmaw Rapids in the Kingdom of Uraya during Would-Be Mercs.
Nax is an NPC in . She is a Phonex who can be found in the Indoline Praetorium on the roof near Silktu Textiles. Nax can only be spoken to if Nim is in the party with level 1 "Phonex Linguistics".

No Love Lost (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Sword Tonfa. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Peerless Blow.
Nessa is an NPC in . She is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. She runs a shop called Whelza Accessories.
Nattua is an NPC in . She is an Indoline who can be found at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium. She offers the Merc Mission Vessel Scrapping.
Nature Boy (Japanese: , Nachuraru, Natural) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Floren at the Gwenith Paddies in the Kingdom of Uraya after completing Unspoken Suspicion.

Nim-Speak is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Ardainian Garrison in Temperantia and is available after resting at Lemour Inn in the Argentum Trade Guild with Nim in the party. It features a conversation about talking to Titans between Nim, her Driver, and Tora. Pandoria can be involved if the second option is chosen.
Naphthea is an NPC in . She is a Tantalese who can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal. She offers the Merc Mission Children's Snowsuit.

Nicc is an NPC in . Nicc is a Gormotti mercenary who can be found at Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya, by the Training Ground. He claims to have been looked after by Vandham when he was younger, because of this he looks up to Vandham and his friends. Jelved blames him for the death of his parents, he is found at the Grave Robbers' Haunt in Spirit Crucible Elpys during Difficult Decisions along with Corden and Kathira.

Mòrag the Chef is a Heart-to-Heart in . It can be found at Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild, by Fishy Fishy. Staying at Lemour Inn before viewing this Heart-to-Heart may trigger dialogue hinting at its location. Viewing this Heart-to-Heart is required to unlock Pyra's level 4 "Resplendence" Battle Skill.

Natural Guard is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases Affinity by up to 10 every time a party member takes damage. It can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

Niall's Underwear is a Key Item in . It is underwear owned by Niall. It can be obtained by Boreas or Mòrag during the quest Hero of the Nopon. There is an optional Field Skill check of the level 3 "Fleet of Foot". If this check is failed, or if the player chose not to have Boreas steal the underwear, then Mòrag will steal the underwear instead.
Noganga is an NPC in . Noganga is a Nopon who can be found in the Goldmouth Wheelhouse in the Argentum Trade Guild. Noganga gives the quest Birds of a Feather.
Nookka Aspids (Japanese: , Nokkā Asupīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspid family, and can be found at level 36-40 in the Empire of Mor Ardain after Salvaging near the Chansagh Wastes.

The Narb Driver (Japanese: , Nābu Doraibā) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . He is a Driver who is fought at level 33 at the Blossomshade Cliff in the Kingdom of Uraya during the quest Nature Boy alongside Angry Durro and the Ganaf Driver.
Nel is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian salvager who can be found on the Salvage Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild during Eternal Spirit.
Nonono is an NPC in . Nonono can be found at the Ruins of Judicium in Temperantia. Nonono is one of the Twelve Brothersisterpon.

Neyaya is an NPC in . Neyaya can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha. Neyaya is one of the Twelve Brothersisterpon. Neyaya can be found in the cave-in, crater-like hole in the floor near the Balquors Ruins Skip Travel point. When in the crater, Neyaya is located behind one of the collection points, but only after Chapter 8. Neyaya is searching for Linka Honey. After obtaining some from the Collection Point next to the Runo Cave-in Skip Travel point, speak to her again. Neyaya will go back to Twelve Brothersisterpon.

Mythra Vs. Brighid is a Heart-to-Heart in . It can be found near the Fallen Skyscraper in the Land of Morytha. Viewing this Heart-to-Heart is required to unlock Mythra's level 5 "Foresight" Battle Skill.

Natka is an NPC in . She is a Gormotti anti-Blade refugee who can be found at the Refugee Campground in the Indoline Praetorium, having fled Gormott during the Gormott-Mor Ardain war. Natka offers no quests or Merc Missions.

Nazya is an NPC in . She is a Gormotti who can be found at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium. She runs the shop Cookie Seller. After Chapter 8, she moves to the Torigoth Relay Base in the Gormott Province.

Mythra-Style Pyra (Japanese: ) is a DLC Aux Core in . It boosts the Critical Hit Rate of the Blade by 20%. It also changes Pyra's appearance when she equips the core, granting her Mythra's color scheme. It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange for 25 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. The DLC exclusive Massive Melee Mythra Aux Core offers a stronger version of this equipment's effect. The Blue Sky Pyra DLC Aux Core also has an equivalent effect, which is functionally identical to the Critical Up V Aux Core.

Nekkel Mammuts (Japanese: , Nedokera Mamūto) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are two members of the Mammut family that are fought at level 104 during wave three of the Challenge Battle Dino Drama. This enemy drops no items.

Nitro Sovereigns (Japanese: , Nitoro Roiyaru) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are Radclyffe-type Sovereigns that are fought at level 96 during the Challenge Battle Mk. VIII. Four appear during wave 2 along with Strategizer Nitro. They act similar to most Radclyffe Sovereigns, but their self-destruct inflicts more damage. This enemy drops no items.

Nesting Wisps (Japanese: , Nesuto Ranpusu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Wisp family, and can be found at level 62 during Wave 3 of Call the Exterminators, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Noise Dampeners (Japanese: , Noizu Kyanserā) are DLC accessories in . They increase the damage ratio of Arts used to cancel an action by up to 69%. Unlike what the item's description might suggest, the effect will not only apply when cancelling Auto-Attacks, but also when cancelling Blade Switches and other Arts. They are the upgraded version of the Eyepatch, Leader's Eyepatch and Hi-Tech Eyepatch accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Night-vision Kits (Japanese: , Nokutobijon) are DLC accessories in . They allow for dropped items like enemy drops, HP Potions, Collectibles and Ether Cubes to be collected from farther away. Default collection range of 0.5 meters is increased up to 1.6 meters. This effect stacks with the 2.5 meters of additional range provided by the Cleo Deeds, Llysiau Deeds, Tomi Deeds, Volty Deeds and Adelno Deeds, allowing for up to 4.1 meters of total range. This range increase will also apply outside of battle. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Cha

Naddie is an Urayan in . She stands by the stairs connecting the lower and upper levels of the Commercial District of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. She is an old friend of Vandham's, having been his comrade during one of their earliest missions.
Nemesis Beat (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Monado. This art recycles Zeke's Detonation Blow.
Near Bulge Harbor in the Empire of Mor Ardain is a Salvage Point in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. It appears only when the tide of the Cloud Sea is high. __TOC__
A Salvage Point can be found near Chansagh Wastes in the Empire of Mor Ardain in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. Kasandra's Core Crystal may be acquired here from the Gluttonous Marrin. __TOC__
A Salvage Point in can be found near Jubilee Gate on the Cliffs of Morytha.
A Salvage Point can be found near Morytha Falls on the Cliffs of Morytha in . __TOC__
A Salvage Point can be found near Port Deck aboard the Titan Battleship in Gormott Province. It can be reached by leaving the Port Deck by clambering over the ship's hull and dropping down. __TOC__
Near Rigitte Harbor is a Salvage Point in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. __TOC__

The Nameless Sentinel (Japanese: , Shugosha Nōnēmu) is a Quest-Exclusive Boss in . It is an Artifice, and is fought at level 125 at Lv. 3, Alioth in the World Tree during the DLC quest Mystery Launch Codes. It looks like the standard Artifice Colossus but appears more tattered, and has much higher stats than those of some Superbosses.

Nano Orange QTπ (Japanese: , Hana JD Orange Custom) is a DLC Skill RAM or Upgrade in . It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. It is unlocked after the Nopon Invitation is collected from the Helpful New Features released as part of the version 1.5.1 update and can be purchased at the Noponstone Exchange for 200 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge. It gives Poppi QTπ a new color scheme; her armor is lighter and her scarf becomes orange, while her hair becomes green

Nascion is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be first found on the Isle of Urchon in the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark. He can then be found at the Fonsett Residential Area.

NoponGro: Bravery (Japanese: , Tora no Idea Seichō: Yūki) is a DLC Key Item in . It can be traded for at Noponstone Exchange after obtaining the Nopon Invitation. They cost 1 Noponstone apiece and can be used to increase Tora's Bravery Idea Stat.

NoponGro: Truth (Japanese: , Tora no Idea Seichō: Seijitsu) is a DLC Key Item in . It can be traded for at Noponstone Exchange after obtaining the Nopon Invitation. They cost 1 Noponstone apiece and can be used to increase Tora's Truth Idea Stat.

NoponGro: Compassion (Japanese: , Tora no Idea Seichō: Jihi) is a DLC Key Item in . It can be traded for at Noponstone Exchange after obtaining the Nopon Invitation. They cost 1 Noponstone apiece and can be used to increase Tora's Compassion Idea Stat.

NoponGro: Justice (Japanese: , Tora no Idea Seichō: Seigi) is a DLC Key Item in . It can be traded for at Noponstone Exchange after obtaining the Nopon Invitation. They cost 1 Noponstone apiece and can be used to increase Tora's Justice Idea Stat.
Night Breaker (Japanese: , Naitobureikā) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when wielding an Uchigatana. This art recycles Rex's Feral Blade.
Nightfire (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when wielding Dual Swords.

Night Magra Quadwings (Japanese: , Nokkusumagia Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found during at night at level 2-3 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly near the Lasaria Woodland.

Nebley Wind Cave (Japanese: , Nebura no Kazaana) is a location in . It is located in the northeastern area of Gormott, below the Hoary Weald, and can be accessed by swimming through a wide tunnel in the northwestern corner of Coolley Lake, or by taking a similar route by the southeastern shore of the body of water north of Valafum Hill. There is an ether miasma, several Collection Points and several green barrels containing Red Pollen Orbs here.

Nemus Camills (Japanese: , Nemusu Kamiru) are enemies in . They are members of the Camill family and can be found at level 8 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, particularly in the Cropwoods of Yorn.

The New Weapon Blueprint is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Zo Zinath asks the party to obtain it during Plans of Attack. It is found in an Alien Container in a building in Sylvalum's Badr Stronghold.

Nomadic Rusholme (Japanese: , Rurō no Rashu Boruto) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Griffox family and can be found at level 44 in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, at Behemoth's Roost after having defeated the Grafton Feris which is initially there.
Nest Extracts are Enemy Part collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.
New Difficulty Levels is a DLC Key Item in . It is part of the New Difficulty Levels pack. By receiving this item, it is possible to change the difficulty settings to Bringer of Chaos and Custom.
Noggle Bunnits (Japanese: , Niigeru Banitto) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family and can be found at level 10 - 13 in the Ordia Great Plains in Gormott.
Noble Aspar (Japanese: , Nōburu Angu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Aspar family, and can be found at level 13-17 on Ordia Great Plains and Lyanne Meadow in Gormott.

Nalsaz is an NPC in . He is a Tornan man who can first be found at Yanchik Harbor in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna. In late game after achieving Level 4 Community, Nalsaz can be found standing in Orem Storage Ward of Auresco, and speaking to him here gains his Community.

Nereus Quadwings (Japanese: , Nerēdo Kurōdo) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 21-23 on Wrackham Moor in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna at night.

Noowl is an NPC in . He is a young Gormotti man who can be found at the Aletta: Militia Garrison in the Kingdom of Torna. He and Kaleena oversee the garrison in Addam's absence. He gives the quest The Travails of War, and his Community is gained upon its completion.

Nittle is an NPC in . He is a Tornan official who can be found near the Aureus Palace at Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna. He gives the quest Trail of Destruction, and his Community is gained alongside Bry's upon its completion.

The Nameless Wanderpon is an NPC in . He is a Nopon traveller who is found at Feltley Village in the Kingdom of Torna. Upon being spoken to, he offers the Massive Melee Mythra Aux Core. The Nameless Wanderpon goes unnamed as he is not part of the original Community.

The Navvir Highland (Japanese: , Nabiru Kōchi) is a location in . It is a large open plain on the Bionis' Shoulder, south of Junks, east of Clear Sky Bluff, and north of Companions' Cape. A Quiet Moment, "A Love for Flowers", between Melia and Nene can be found on the land struts on the west edge of the highland. A Pororo's Favourite can be found in the south-west area. The Navvir Crossroads landmark is to the north. Plump Wildgrass must be collected here during Plump Pickings.

Navvir Crossroads (Japanese: , Nabiru Mitsumataji) is a landmark in . It is located on the Bionis' Shoulder, south of Junks and linking the roads across Navvir Highland and Clear Sky Bluff. There are no enemies directly at the crossroads, and the first accessible Ponspector, Tei-Tei, can be found here.

The Nerthis Necropolis Gate (Japanese: , Neruvusu Bochi: Iriguchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Bionis' Shoulder directly before the Nerthis Necropolis, and can be reached by ascending Clear Sky Bluff on the high path starting from Navvir Crossroads. There are no enemies, NPCs or objects here.

The Nerthis Necropolis (Japanese: , Neruvusu Bochi) is a location in . It is located on the Bionis' Shoulder, beyond the Nerthis Necropolis Gate up the high path from Navvir Crossroads and primarily contains level 73-74 Arachnos. It is a Giant crypt that must be visited during the quests Tei-Tei Lacking Charm, Steady on, Grandad!, and Ponspectors Till We Cry. There is a tunnel leading to a Giants' Trove containing a Double Attack IV gem, and a sealed wall that is opened during Ponspectors Till We Cry for treasure-hunting purposes. By examining the treasure chest in the back room, the party can receive a Dried Golden Shroom.

Nestinor is a High Entia child NPC in . He can be found along the north shore of the Tranquil Tarn near Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder. After he becomes Angela's friend during the quest Wallflower, he relocates to the log pile by the Armu pen within Gran Dell to play with her and other new friends. After the Teelan's Laboratory attack event, if Wallflower has already been completed, he offers the quest Sorrow. Upon acceptance of the quest, he moves to Heroes' Rest.

Nonona (Japanese: , Noino) is a Nopon in . He is a Ponspector of the red team met at the Old Expedition HQ on the Bionis' Shoulder. He gives the quest Nonona's Calling, tasking the party by convoluted directions to retrieve his license. Nonona has been Ponspecting for three years, and is given to exaggerating events to make them sound like epics.
Nonona's Calling (Japanese: , Sadame no Noino) is a quest in . It can be received from Nonona on Bionis' Shoulder. Completing it will add Nonona to the group of active Ponspectors.
Nonona's License are is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. It is needed for Nonona's Calling given by Nonona.

No Armu Done (Japanese: , Aruma-kai no Junan) is a surprise quest in . It can be received by going near Laffaelle west of Thulles Way on the Bionis' Shoulder. Upon completion of the quest Laffaelle will return to Gran Dell.
New Way of Life (Japanese: , Atarashii Kurashi) is a quest in . It can be received from Ines in the Halcyon Wheats on the Bionis' Shoulder.

Nanoceroses (Japanese: , Tondeikinasai) are collectables in . They can be found in Alcamoth, in particular around the Main Entrance, the Fountain of Eternity and Melfica Road. According to their description, they are rhinos that are as small as a grain of sand and they are sometimes blown away in the wind.

Neilnail (Japanese: , Nīru Nēru, Neil Nail; English dub: ), or simply Neil ), is a recruitable character in . She is a Qlurian who seemingly has a connection with the Neilnail Albus and Neilnail Furvus Skells. She is an archaeologist focusing on the study of alien civilizations, and is particularly interested in the culture of the people of Earth.

The Nerthis Crown is a heavy head armour exclusive to Melia in . It is available as a reward for completing the quest Ponspectors Till We Cry. When worn, all Ponspectors start the battle with high tension.
Noise Suppressors are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They are the initial starting equipment for Shulk, and can only be worn by him.
Nexus Force (Japanese: ) is Rex and Nia's Level IV Blade Special in if both Nia and Pyra are at Max Affinity in battle after the fight against Jin in Chapter 9.

Noble Arachnids (Japanese: , Nōburu Arakunido) are two Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Scirpos, and can be found between level 20 and 22 at South Cinderdunes in Sylvalum. One must be defeated in order to obtain a Noble Silk required during Predator and Prey A route.

Mythra's "Creative" cuisine is a skill in , with which Mythra can prepare Pouch food items from various Collectibles at campsites. These recipes and items are unique to Mythra and cannot be obtained any other way. Recipes are unlocked by receiving them during certain Quests or gaining Community. Mythra can cook several items from each food type, being Staple Foods, Meats, Seafood and Desserts.

Noble Taunt (Japanese: , Nōburutaunto) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Guardian Commander class. It becomes a usable Master Art upon unlocking the class. The user raises their sword daring enemies to attack them.

Nestrand Crustips are five Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 11 around the Ferronis Hulk on Viliera Hill in Millick Meadows during The Hillside Hulk.
Noogie Storm (Japanese: , Bokaboka Sutōmu) is a Chain Art in . It is Riku & Manana's Chain art during a Chain Attack.

Nih'l Valley (Japanese: , Nīru no Tani) is a location in , located south of Colony 4 in the Eagus Wilderness. When the party is attacked by Colony 4 and escape into Bennel Cave, a large boulder falls onto the road from Racine's Platter into Nih'l Valley. This boulder is present until the party leaves for Ribbi Flats.
Night Hunt (Japanese: , Naitohanto) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Stalker class. It becomes a usable Master Art upon achieving Rank 10 with the class.

N'ohm Wetlands (Japanese: , No Omu Shitchitai) is a Location in . It is located at the Great Sword's Base in the Cadensia Region. The remains of both a small and large Leftherian Titan can be found here.

The Namba Mound Camp (Japanese: , Nabamu Kyūryō no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located at the Namba Mound in Dannagh Desert. Sunny, Cheerio, Sumomo, and Totoma can be found here after completing Champion of the Nopon, as members of the Sunny & Cheerio's Caravan stationed here.
Nocclia Mire (Japanese: , Nokirua Fuhaidamari) is a Landmark in . It is located at Captocorn Peak. Colony 0 is located here until In Search of a Home.

Night-Stalker Volodya (Japanese: , Yatō no Burādi) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Vang family, and can be found at level 43 deep within Torus Hollow on Elaice Highway. The Accelerator Organ Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Navigator Helios (Japanese: , Junkōgata Heriosu) is a Unique Monster in . It is an Testudo type Agnian Levnis, and can be found at level 48 at the Erythia Relay Base in Erythia Sea. The Reckless Attack Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Naval Gyrus (Japanese: , Suigun no Gyoruzu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Krodlax family, and can be found at level 75 near Irma's Secret Base in Erythia Sea. The Trout Hop Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
Nid Cave (Japanese: , Nido no Dōkutsu) is a Location in . It is a cave located on Elaice Highway in the Fornis Region.
Namba Mound (Japanese: , Nabamu Kyūryō) is a Location in . It is located in Dannagh Desert in the Fornis Region. The Namba Mound Camp Rest Spot is located here.
Needle Reef Beach (Japanese: , Senkakushō no Sunahama) is a location in , located in Erythia Sea, southwest of Searing Strand. The Unique Monster Littlefort Morley can be found near here.
No Want of Courage (Japanese: , Gi wo Mitesezaru wa) is a Hero Quest in , dedicated to Ethel. Completion of this quest is required to continue the story.
Natural Selection (Japanese: , Shizen) is a Hero Quest in , dedicated to Juniper. Completing this quest is required to progress the story.
Naberius Bunnits are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 42-43 on Everblight Plain in the Aetia Region.
No. 13 (Japanese: , Nii Gou, Number 2) is a character in . She is a former member of Colony 0.
Neuro Connectors are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Neo Walnuts are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Mu Caravan, or produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Nairoo Hoxes are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Hox family, and can be found at level 48 on Anu Shoals in Erythia Sea or at level 46 in the Sea-Gnawed Cave at the Agnus Castle Barbican.
Nahtei Quadwings are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 46-48 in the Perimeter Woodland of Li Garte Prison Camp.
Nico (Japanese: , Niko) is a NPC in . Nico is from Colony Mu. She has an unusual speech pattern, referring to herself in third person then immediately clarifying that she is talking about herself.
No. 9's Instrument is a Key Item in . It is No. 9's Off-seer flute after its damages are repaired by Giddygiddy during Contrary Emotions.
Noog Fliers are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Flier family, and can be found at level 60-62 at Great Cotte Falls and in High Maktha Wildwood.

N and M is a Time Attack Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the second part of the Expansion Pass. Clearing this challenge with at least an A rank for the first time will reward the party with Accomplished Vambraces.
Mystic Vision (Japanese: , Misutikkuvijon) is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Incursor class. The user poses with their sword increasing their critical rate.
Nanotech Gloves are DLC Accessories in . They can be purchased from Prize X-change Red in the Land of Challenge for 6000 Noponstones.
Nandun is a NPC in who can be found in Colony Mu after choosing the perfect pairings at the Colony Mu, Respite Ranch for the quest The Future I Want to Spin.

Neck Slice is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Forsaken Arbiter while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Nia - Toward the Heavens is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track fourteen of disc eight from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track fourteen of disc nineteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is a remix of Drifting Soul from . This song plays during the following moments: * The appearance of the Cloudkeep next to Captocorn Peak. * The party finding a sleeping Nia. * Nia greeting the party after reawakening. * Nia telling the party about her worries for the future during Grasping My Future. This song also plays during the second part of the credits.
Nebula Fossils are Fossil Collectibles in . They can be found on the Aurora Shelf. They are fossilized Nebulae.

Naberius Invictus (Japanese: , Gunshin no Naberiusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Sagittarius type Levnis, and can be found at level 40 alongside a Keves Trooper and Keves Warrior at Magwall Road on The Ragmos Desolation.
The New Liberator Recruits are three Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are Liberators Soldiers who are fought at level 25 at Outlook Park in Yesterdale during Instructor Panacea.
The Nightmare Feris is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a Fogbeast Feris that is fought at level 28 on the Aurora Shelf during Hunt for the Kids.
Nest Treacles are items in . They can be dropped by Skeeter Nests on the Aurora Shelf.
The Naljot Tirkins two Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Tirkin family that are fought at level 24 in the Agni's Tomb Ruins on the Aurora Shelf during Bobobi's Bad, Bad Day.

New Battle!!! is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track two of disc nine on the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack. This music is heard whenever the party engages an enemy in battle in the Cent-Omnia Region, except in Yesterdale. The song also plays when battling Fogdweller Abaasy instead of You Will Know Our Names - Finale. This track uses motifs from Mechanical Rhythm and Still, Move Forward!.

Noah and N is a track from and , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track four of disc eight on the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track four of disc nineteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the battle against N in Origin and during the battles against N in .

Noah and Mio - Our Melody is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track sixteen of disc eight from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track sixteen of disc nineteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the post-credits cutscene, when time resumes following Origin's reactivation. It is a shorter version of A Life Sent On, with a larger focus on Noah's part.

Nearing the Enemy is a track from , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track three of disc two from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track three of disc thirteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * When Noah, Eunie, and Lanz split off from the other Colony 9 soldiers during the operation in Alfeto Valley. * When Taion considers how the soldiers of Colony 4 seemingly lack any tactics while the party is being pursued by them in the Eagus Wilderness. * The party's confrontation with Valdi during The Kind Right Hand. * When the party is confronted by a mysterious Levnis in High Maktha Wildwood. * During the party's infiltratio

Nintendo (Japanese: 任天堂 Nintendō) is a video game and video game console company based in Kyoto, Japan, with other divisions in the United States, Canada, Australia, and Europe. It is known for several popular video game franchises such as Mario, The Legend of Zelda, and Pokémon. It was founded in 1889 by Fusajiro Yamauchi and produced playing cards. It is recognized as being among the largest producer of video games and has sold more than two billion video games worldwide. Over time, Nintendo has manufactured notable home video game consoles: such as the Nintendo Entertainment System, the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, the Nintendo 64, the Nintendo GameCube, the Wii, Wii U, the Ninten
Neil's Bodywear is Casual Wear torso armor in . It is manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group. It is part of Neilnail's initial gear when she is recruited, and cannot be obtained any other way.
Next-Gen Assault Shrad (Japanese: , Jisedai Kyōshū-gata Zuttā) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Shrad family. It can be found at level 58 in Volitaris.
Nedward is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found in the Admar Storage Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is spoken to during the quest The Ties That Bind.
Natural Pearls are ten Important Items in . They are collected during the course of Marry Me! and are given by Hope during Hope Springs Eternal.
The New-Weapon Remains is an Important Item in . It is collected in the Divine Roost in Noctilum during the course of Test Data Retrieval.
Myth Splitter is a Chain Art in . It is Shimmer's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
Nansae is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian soldier who can be found at the Dalnes Stone in Temperantia during Dagas's Past: Folktales.

Ogre Bunnias are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnia family, and can be found at level 25 north of the Glowing Obelisk in Satorl Marsh. Defeating eight of them is required to complete the quest Zazadan in Danger given by Zazadan in Satorl Marsh. They can drop Bunnia Scent Wood when defeated, which is required for the second part of A Young Captain's Challenge if Emmy Leater is brought the Nopon Claymore and for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

The Nopon Claymore is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of two choices that can be given to Emmy Leater for A Young Captain's Challenge. It can be obtained from a Nopon merchant at the Sororal Statues in Satorl Marsh, or at the Nopon Merchant Camp after the events at Mechonis Core despite the detail of the quest objective. The merchant needs four Bunnia Scent Woods to complete the Claymore, and once the party gives him those he gives the party the Claymore.

Oil Branches (Japanese: , Oiru Buranchi) are collectables in . They can be found in the Eryth Sea. According to their description, they are branches with oily sap that gets someone's hands greasy just from touching them. Two are required for the Colony 6 Reconstruction. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 6,300 Noponstones.

Npa (Japanese: ) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. She is in charge of the food in Frontier Village, and can be found in the Underground Store from 06:00 to 18:00. She is responsible for the village's food supply.

Oleksiy (Japanese: , Orukuhongu) is a Homs in . He can be found on the balcony in the rear of the warehouse to the right of the Gem Man's Stall in Colony 9. After he has been invited to Colony 6, he can be traded with for a Golden Cog, one of the items needed for the "Other" section in the Collectopaedia. After he has moved to Colony 6, he can be found near the base of the watchtower from 15:00 to 0:00. After completing the quest Family Secrets, he can be found speaking with Zel Argentis at 17:00. During Stopping the Elopement he can be found in Satorl Marsh.
Olga (Japanese: , Oruga) is a Homs in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found at the cave entrance of the Refugee Camp. Then she can be found directly north of Juju at Reconstruction HQ in Colony 6.

Obsessive Galgaron (Japanese: , Shūnen no Garugaron) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Orluga family with a Hode riding on top of its back, and can be found at level 35 in the Hode Lair in Makna Forest. It is a sight category monster. It can be reached after receiving the quest Beat Kilaki to it!. Defeating Obsessive Galgaron is the objective of the quest Beat Kilaki to it!. It can also drop a Fancy Orluga Mask, five of which are needed for Material Quest 2.

Norara (Japanese: , Nora) is a Nopon in . She initially resides in Frontier Village, and can be found under the Entry Bridge, near the west wall. If she moves to Colony 6, she can be found on the balcony of a two-level house on the south side of the main street.

Oil Oysters (Japanese: , Oiru Oisutā) are collectables in . They can be found on the Fallen Arm and in Colony 6. According to their description, they are beautiful oysters which colour of their shells changes when they are hit by light. Three are required for Colony 6 Reconstruction. In , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 5,200 Noponstones.

The Nopon Refuge (Japanese: , Nopon no Kakurega) is a location in . It is a small cave in Satorl Marsh, south from Basin Cave, east from Barren Moor, northeast from Exile Fortress, and north from the Glowing Obelisk. The shortest way is from the Glowing Obelisk. The Red Pollen Orb, needed for A Big/Little Brother's Fight, can be found here.

Oil Foxes (Japanese: , Oiru Kitsune) are collectables in . They can be found in the Central Factory and Colony 6. According to their description, they are foxes with damp fur and their misty eyes make them look adorable.

Nopon Caps (Japanese: , Nopon Kyappu) are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is part of Riki's initial armour, and is otherwise obtainable through trading. It is part of the Nopon equipment series along with the Nopon Top, Gloves, Bottoms and Shoes.

The Nopon Tower (Japanese: , Nopontawā) is a landmark in . It is found outside the main part of Frontier Village. It is a large wooden tower inhabited by Nopon. Since the doors cannot be entered, the only way to get on top of the tower is by jumping off a branch near the ledge outside the Middle Housing Level. The Nopon Tower was brought to Frontier Village by Chief Dunga. A Heart-to-Heart - "A Day Like Any Other" - is located here.

The Nopon Merchant Camp (Japanese: , Nopon Shōkai Kyanpu) is a landmark in . It is located in Satorl Marsh, in the middle of Lacus Swamp. As its name implies, it is a camp where Nopon merchants make their home. The Nopon Merchant Camp Shop can be found here. Many of the quests for Satorl Marsh are given here. No monsters appear around this camp. After the events at Mechonis Core, the Nopon Merchant who only spreads information, but gave the The Ancient Ceremony and Ancient Ceremony Offerings story quests, and is involved in the quest A Young Captain's Challenge as the Nopon Claymore giver, will move there.

Old Dragon Spines are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Racti Lexos in Eryth Sea, or traded for in Eryth Sea and Alcamoth. According to their description, they taste nice either stewed or fried and they are considered spine-tinglingly delicious. Three are needed for Collect Quest 2 (Eryth Sea).
Nopon Shoes are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They form part of Riki's initial armour, and are not otherwise obtainable.
Nopon Bottoms are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is part of Riki's original armour, and can otherwise be obtained through trading.
Nopon Gloves are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are commonly worn by Nopon. They form part of Riki's initial armour, and are not otherwise obtainable.
The Nopon Top is light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is Riki's initial torso armour when he joins the party at Frontier Village, and is not otherwise obtainable.

Oka (Japanese: ; English dub: ) is a Nopon in . She is Riki's wife (or wifeypon) and mother to eleven children, including Kino, Nene, and Riku. She can be found in Frontier Village at Riki's House between from 9:00 to 18:00, pacing back and forth and watching her children. She does not seem to think too highly of Riki, mentioning that "The littlepon have been getting big while [he] has been away," and even going so far as to threaten divorce if Riki does not make enough money to clear his debts and improve their standard of living. She is said to have quite a temper as well — during a quest, Riki tells Dabidabi that Oka was so furious with him for asking her to marry him that she slapp

The Observation Platform (Japanese: , Kaitaku-sha no Tenbō-dai) is a Secret Area in . It is located on the upper level of Bionis' Leg. It is accessed by following a narrow path along the edge of a cliff at Daksha Shrine on the lower level, and then going through a cave passage. The Observation Platform gives a good view of the lower level of Bionis' Leg. It is located west of Traveller's Rest. A level 76 Dark Hox and two level 75 Tempest Vangs are in the tunnel; however, the party can sneak past them. At the Observation Platform itself, the Unique Monster Canyon Valencia can occasionally be seen as it goes along its circuit around Raguel Lake's airspace.
A Northern Pike (Japanese: , Nozanpaiku) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a gunlance wielded by Reyn.

The Offensive Strike Unit (Japanese: , Kyōka Yunitto Kyōshūshiki) is a quest-exclusive Mechon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be found at level 72 at the Black Wreckage. It only spawns during the quest Transmission Bypass given by Orkatix in the Hidden Machina Village. It must be defeated to receive the quest item Transmission Bypass.

The Offensive Hover Unit (Japanese: , Fuyū Yunitto Kyōshūshiki) is a quest-exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Mechon, and can be found at level 72 near Digit 4 on the Fallen Arm during The Exhaust Pump. It must be defeated to get the Exhaust Pump for Orkatix. This enemy deals close range Spike damage.
The Nopon Cannon (Japanese: , Noponkyanon) is a weapon that appeared in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is an ether rifle that can only be obtained by purchasing it at the Frontier Village Weapon Shop.
Omega Break (Japanese: , Omegabureiku) are Unique weapons in . They are twin blades wielded by Fiora.
The Official's Staff (Japanese: , Fūinkan no Tsue, Seal Official's Staff) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a staff that can be wielded by Melia.

Officer Volffs are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 25 in Satorl Marsh during the day, often accompanied by Satorl Volffs. There are four in the lowland east of Igna Territory; one along the path north of Silent Obelisk in Barren Moor; and one at a point southeast of Poison Swamp and due southwest of the Ether Crystal deposit. One must be defeated to complete the Satorl Marsh's Monster Quest 4. They can drop the Fancy Volff Hides needed for Making Camp.

The Oath Sanctuary (Japanese: , Seisei no Seijo) is a location in . It is located in Satorl Marsh. It is a circular platform located on the cliff southeast of Mauk Floodgate, and north of the Soter Ruins. It is of High Entia origin, and Scarlen can be found here after the events at the Mechonis Core, before The Imperial Ceremony is completed.

The Nopon Kitchen (Japanese: , Nopon no Daidokoro) is a location in . It is located in the basement of Frontier Village. During the night there is a mysterious sound coming from behind the hole covered with wooden plank. It is unknown what causes it.

Odd Smoke - Investigation (Japanese: , Ayashii Kemuri: Chōsa-hen) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Arda on the main street east of Reconstruction HQ in Colony 6. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment. After completing this quest, Odd Smoke - Resolution will be available.

The Nopon Potion is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is required for It's All in the Mind. It can be found by climbing the slope to the south of the Nopon Merchant Camp in Satorl Marsh's Lacus Swamp and going through the cave.
Old Insect Legs are common materials in . They are dropped by three types of Insect Enemies and can be traded for.

Odd Smoke - Resolution (Japanese: , Ayashii Kemuri: Kaiketsu-hen) is a quest in . It can be received from Jer'ell on the main street east of Reconstruction HQ and south of the Nopon shop in Colony 6. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment.

The Nopon Coin is a Key Item in . Daza asks the party to retrieve it during Proof of Status so that he can prove his status as a Nopon Merchant and be allowed to trade. It can be found on a side branch of the Splintered Path in Colony 6.

Officer Robusto (Japanese: , Shōkō no Robusuto) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Selua family, and can be found at level 75 near the platform just beneath Venous Plexus in Bionis' Interior.
The Old Ring is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is given to the party during Thawing Relations by Zukazu, and must be given to Marcia.

Officer Arachnos (Japanese: , Ofisā Supaido) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 11 in Tephra Cave between Tephra Cavern and Vilia Lake.

Oasis Flamiis (Japanese: , Oashisu Furamī) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found at level 17 on the shores of Raguel Lake on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Fertile Flamii Eggs needed for Material Quest 1.

Offensive Mechon Plus (Japanese: , Kyōshūshiki Kishinhei: Kō) are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 49 in Sword Valley at the 3rd Gate, between the 3rd and 4th Gates, between the 4th and 5th Gates, at the Control Tower, Enalda Control Base, Ether Storage Area, Monado Wound, and Port Maintenance Bay.

Offensive Scout Units (Japanese: , Kyōshūshiki Kanshi-gata) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Mechon, and can be found in the Ether Blast Furnace in Galahad Fortress. They can drop the Refined Part Ms needed for Restoring the Capital 2. However, by the time the quest is available, they cannot be defeated anymore.

The Offensive Scout (Japanese: , Kyōshūshiki Teisatsu Chōki) is a story exclusive and quest exclusive Mechon enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is not a Unique Monster. It can be found at level 62 in Central Factory on a catwalk west of the Central Lift. It only appears during the quest Materials for a Bomb, and drops the Timer required to complete Materials for a Bomb. It also drops a Reinforced Jet, which can be used to complete Best Boots. Despite the similar name, it is not the same as the Offensive/SCOUTs found in Mechonis Field.
The Observation Point (Japanese: , Saikutsu Kanshijo) is a location in . It is located on the ground floor of the Ether Mine, and becomes inaccessable after Xord is defeated.
Normal Parts M are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Mechon or be traded for.
Old Dragon Fangs are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Sesna Lexos and Sestago Lexos.
Old Parts S are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Mechon prototypes, or be traded for with Orkatix.
Old Parts M are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the M87 Prototype, or traded for with Voltak.
Normal Parts L are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by large Mechon in Sword valley, or be traded for.
Normal Parts S are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various small Mechon, or be traded for.
Old Remote Devices are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Orluga Rufus in the High Entia Tomb, or traded for with Teelan.
Nopon Merchants (Japanese: , Nopon-shō) are NPCs in and . __TOC__
One Year On (Japanese: , Ichinenmae no Taisen, The Great Battle a Year Past) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Pod Depot in Colony 6, between Reyn and Dunban at purple affinity.

The North Janpath Plain (Japanese: , Janpasu-ko no Kita Heigen) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, north of Janpath Lake, west of La Mancha, and east of Tallpach Peak.
Omari (Japanese: , Omari) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Omari can be found at West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Offensive Stance is a Longsword Battle Art in . It boosts melee accuracy and melee attack, but causes its user to take increased damage from attacks.

Oblivia (Japanese: , Bōkyaku no Keikoku lit. Valley of Oblivion; English dub: ), also known as Sandy Bum Canyon (Japanese: , Menisuna Dani) to the Nopon, is a region in . It lies to the east of Primordia. Oblivia is a dry, arid region with sparse vegetation. More enigmatically, it contains numerous ruins, is interwoven with gigantic metal water pipes, and hosts several colossal ring-like structures left over from a forgotten alien race that once lived in ancient Mira. Oblivia's most dominating geographical feature is the Yawning Giant, a vast dry inland chasm plunging far below sea level, whose depths are shrouded in thick layers of air which obscure the chasm's floor. __TOC__
The Northpointe Cove (Japanese: , Nōsumousuto no Irie) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, northeast of Sayram Northeast Plain.

NLA is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X, composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track four of disc three from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack. This music is heard while the party is in New Los Angeles.
The Nopon Merchant Camp Shop is a shop in . It is the only shop in Satorl Marsh, it is located at the Nopon Merchant Camp. It stocks a few pieces of armour not available elsewhere.
The North Janpath BC (Japanese: , Janpasu-ko Hokubu BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, north of Janpath Lake.
The North Founders Street (Japanese: , Nōsu Daiichi Sutorīto, North 1st Street) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.

Northpointe Beach (Japanese: , Nōsumousuto no Hama) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, southeast of Arendt Bridge and close to FN Site 111. A Lifehold can be found in the nearby waters.

NightL is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X, composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track three of disc three from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, as well as track nine in the digital soundtrack released in the North American special edition, where it has the title NOfCoTreIsLtUM. This music is heard when the party is in Noctilum.

NLA is a track in , composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track two of disc three from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, as well as track eight in the digital soundtrack released in the North American special edition, where it has the title aNrLeAa. This track plays while the party is in Primordia. In , the first part of the song also plays on the Deck and Bridge of the White Whale 2 before it enters Volitaris during Chapter 13 (Act 3).
Old Dragontail Tree (Japanese: , Tatsuo Furuki) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, north of Jasper Incline and next to Rust Lake.

Oblivia Ingress BC (Japanese: , Keikoku Iriguchi, Valley Entrance BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, at the westernmost point of Oblivia Ingress, directly adjacent to the path to Primordia.

The North Silent Sandsea (Japanese: , Otonashi no Sakai Hokubu) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, east of the Anvil Sandplain. It is a large expanse of sand and spore plants. The southern part of North Silent Sandsea contains a small watering hole with North Silent Sandsea BC and FN Site 418 nearby. The western part of North Silent Sandsea has an unnamed anvil-shaped structure with Ganglion enemies atop it.
North Silent Sandsea BC (Japanese: , Otonashi no Sakai Hokubu BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp located in Sylvalum, on the North Silent Sandsea.
Opening Art is a Soul Voice in . It is triggered when a character uses an art instead of drawing the weapon first to start a battle.

The North Coast (Japanese: , Nōsu Kōsuto) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a beach located in Oblivia, west of FN Site 310. The FN Site 308 is located here, and the North Coast Riddle Rock can be found here during A Great Divide.
The North Coast BC (Japanese: , Nōsu Kōsuto BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp, located on the North Coast of Oblivia.
North Hardheart Canyon (Japanese: , Mujō no Keikoku Hokubu) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, at the north end of Hardheart Canyon.

The O'rrh Sim Keep (Japanese: , O-Ra-Shīmu Tenshuen) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, within the O'rrh Sim Castle Ruins. It can be reached by entering the building via the small door at O'rrh Sim Gate and navigating a series of passages and elvators. There are screen-enclosed paths along the sides of the room, but they do not open into the main part of the room and are not considered part of the landmark. The room is normally devoid of enemies, except during a main story mission. After the Force Seidr is defeated here during Chapter 11, the large door is opened, providing direct access from O'rrh Sim Gate and allowing Skells to enter the building.
O'rrh Sim Capital Remains (Japanese: , O-Ra-Shīmu Jōto-ato) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, south of the Ganglion Weapons Hangar.
The Oblivia Collectopedia is a portion of the Collectopedia in Xenoblade Chronicles X.

Nosusu (Japanese: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Nopon and can be found at the Dodonga Caravan in the Whale's Nostril in Noctilum. She can be met after completing the mission The Ties That Bind. She is Tatsu's young sister.
The North Ciel Sandsea (Japanese: , Shieru-ko no Hokubu Sakai) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, northeast of Lake Ciel.

The Northern Searoad (Japanese: , Kita no Kaiendō) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in eastern Sylvalum, north of the Sylvalum Searoad and northeast of the North Hardheart Canyon. A Lifehold unit can be found here, and must be investigated during White Lifehold.
Oliver (Japanese: , Oribā) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found near North Founders Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles during the day.

On'tonam (Japanese: , On'otonamu, English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Deck of the Ma-non Ship, and moving to and at the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles. He is the Director of Orphean Technologies.

The Nopon Braidbridge (Japanese: , Nopon no Henkyō) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a series of woven wooden bridges located above Noctilum. It leads to the Nopon Highroad and the branches of the Skybound Coil Tree, and resembles the nopon bridges around Frontier Village in Xenoblade Chronicles. Although it is named 'Nopon' there are no Nopon here, nor any enemies, although Clemente, the Iron Meteor can be found hidden directly below.

The Nopon Highroad (Japanese: , Nopon Yūhodō) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a series of raised flat plains located in Noctilum, directly above the Canopied Nightwood. It is connected to the Nopon Braidbridge but does not seem to lead anywhere.
North Ant's Nest (Japanese: , Anto Nesuto Hokubu) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a small cave located in Oblivia, on the lip of the Yawning Giant, with four main rooms and one entrance.
Octo-sukas (Japanese: , Okutosuka) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia. They are most common in Sea Whisper Valley, by the water fall.

Noranlilies (Japanese: , Nōran'yuri) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, north of Arendt Bridge, close to Castaway Cavern. Three Noranlilies are required for the Normal Mission Training Day.

Nostalgia L-002s (Japanese: , Nosutarujia L-002) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular near the Great Nail. Eight are needed for Supplies Surprise.
Octopus Regulators (Japanese: , Okutopasu Poddo) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular near FN Site 503. Four are needed for Recycled Octopi.

The Nopon Bazaar (Japanese: , Nopon Bazā) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles, to the north of Central Melville Street at NLA Auto Parks. It becomes a Nopon merchant site after the Affinity Mission BFFs has been completed.
Offing Ovis is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Prospectors and the primary destination is Primordia.

North Cinderdunes (Japanese: , Kita no Kaijin Sakyū) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a plain located in Sylvalum, directly east of the FN Site 410. Professor B can be found here during Professorial, and resources must be investigated here during Brotherly Love.
Old Cervuses (Japanese: , Ōrudo Keruusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cervus family, and can be found at level 54 at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum.
The Old Ceremonial Hollow (Japanese: , Furubita Saishidō) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave located in Cauldros, northeast of Mount M'gando.

O'rrh Sim Gate (Japanese: , O-Ra-Shīmu Jōmonzen) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the O'rrh Sim Castle Ruins in Cauldros. There are two doors here which provide access to the castle interior, one human-sized and one Skell-sized. The former, atop a set of stairs, connects to a series of passages which lead to the building's larger rooms. The larger door connects directly to O'rrh Sim Keep, but cannot be opened until the Force Seidr is defeated during Chapter 11.
O'rrh Sim Watchtowers (Japanese: , O-Ra-Shīmu Shubitō) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, at the level above O'rrh Sim Capital Remains and O'rrh Sim Castle Ruins.

Nupopon Incarnate (Japanese: , Nupopon no Keshin) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Arenatect family and Nupopon's incarnation. It can be found at level 56 at Quay Hollows in Sylvalum and must be defeated during the Normal Mission The Divine Nupopon.

Nopopon Incarnate (Japanese: , Nopopon no Keshin) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Cervus family and Nopopon's incarnation. It can be found at level 68 at Whale's Weeper in Noctilum and must be defeated during the Normal Mission The Divine Nopopon.

Oc-serv, the Ancient (Japanese: , Kodai no Me-Tsuu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Oc-serv machine. It can be found at level 40 on the Sylvalum Searoad. It lies dormant until approached.
Nu-rhor, the Dark Deity (Japanese: , Kokuanshin Nu-roā) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Xe-dom machine. It can be found at level 65 at Jair Fortress in eastern Oblivia.

The Odsent (Japanese: , Odosento) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an allegedly tamed member of the Suid family, having been tamed by Zarch Quokett. It is fought twice at 30 in Primordia during the Normal Mission Training Day. If B route is chosen, Odsent will be fought one more time, at level 33. It does not drops any materials.

Ogre Blattas (Japanese: , Ouga Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 21-30 at FN Site 224 in Noctilum. They stay in front of the tyrant found in the cave.

The Oc-serv Yabars (Japanese: , Me-Tsuu-Yabaru) are five Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and are fought at level 29 on Oblivia's South Coast during Phog's Affinity Mission A Great Divide. Their arts include Arm Swing (physical), Graviton (gravity), Gravity Shell (gravity), and Radius (beam).

|-| XCX= |-| XCX:DE= Off the Record is a Basic Mission in . It is a final test from Solan to get the Mechanical Field-Skill level 5. In the , completing this mission unlocks the Mechanical Field-Skill itself. Part of the test is to correctly interpret the objectives, which are in the form of riddles. For this reason, the locations of the targets are not shown by the minimap, the segment map, nor the Follow Ball. The objectives differ between versions. __NOTOC__
Odorous Tentacles are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Gerrids. Gathering three of them is required during the Normal Mission And Stay Out!.
Nopon Contracts are four Important Items in . They are obtained from the leaders of each of the four Nopon caravans during Sparking a Smile and are given to Ngogo.

The Oc-Serv Seivo (Japanese: , Me-Tsuu-Seivo) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Oc-serv machine, and can be found at level 32 at Badr Basin in Sylvalum. It must be defeated in order to obtain the Ice Cream Cake required during Predator and Prey.
Obsidian Fragments are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Millesaurs and Coronids. One is needed during The Nopon Heir.

Old Dogs and New Tricks is Lin's second Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the corner of West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles, between Lin and Cross in the afternoon, if Cross has a dog as a pet. Lin is out on the town walking with the dog.
Opaque Membranes are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Unafulges or Visigels.
Oche Wolfen (Japanese: , Oche Urufen) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Onze Vilgabo (Japanese: , Ondo Wirugeibo) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found on the Deck of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Obsidian Clusters are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. One is required for the Excavator Skell. They can be obtained from Millesaurs and Coronids.
North Coast Riddle Rocks are three Important Items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Solan asks the party to obtain one of them during A Great Divide.
Oll Valdileo (Japanese: , Oru Barudireo) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles at night. He is the brother of Rada Valdileo.
Nopon Chest is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Dopang Caravan to find Starmakers in Sylvalum.
Nopon Culture 101 is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Mediators to gather Dark Lanterns.
Octo-suka Leg Surprise is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
One Little Problem is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It leads to the Normal Mission Snipe Hunt.
Old Soldiers is Nagi's fourth Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs anytime in the interior of the BLADE Barracks of New Los Angeles.
Off Duty is Yelv's first Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs at late night in the alley west of Barista Court in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Octopus Boards are unique materials in . They can be obtained from Xe-doms. They are used in creating certain Skell Superweapons. One is needed during Definian Downfall A route.

Opaque Mirrors are materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Grexes in Oblivia, or for 42 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. Two are needed for From Idea to Inventory. They are one of the components of Ether Res Up and SpecUp.ETHER-RES augments.

Ocher Stabilizers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from gold Fal-swos with yellow lights, or for 72 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are a component of I and V Beam Res Up and SpecUp.BEAM-RES augments.

Oc-serv Eastern Crests are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black, purple-eyed Oc-servs, or for 98 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Gravity Res Up and SpecUp.GRAV-RES augments.

Oc-serv Northern Crests are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from silver, orange-eyed Oc-servs, or for 78 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Focused Evasion I and V augments.

Oc-serv Western Crests are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from gold, magenta-eyed Oc-servs, or for 78 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Crush: Gain TP and Crush.GP augments.
